- **Platform Type:** Independent Indian Web Application & Digital Wedding Stationery Platform

- **Refund Policy:** 24 ghante me reply, approved refund 5 se 7 working days me original payment source par.

## Origin Story: Why Eternal Vowz Was Built
In an Indian wedding, the invitation is never just information. It is the moment a family says, "you are a part of our celebration." The heavy card, the lifafa you slowly open, the palace motifs, the gold lettering: that feeling is a tradition in itself.
When invitations moved to WhatsApp, that warmth was lost to flat forwarded images and PDFs. Salman Ahmad built Eternal Vowz to restore that royal, tangible dignity to digital wedding cards at an accessible flat price of ₹99.

## Core Capabilities & Technical Architecture
1. **Interactive 3D Lifafa & Palace Gates:** Guests touch or tap to crack animated wax seals or swing open royal palace double doors.
2. **Instant WhatsApp Distribution:** One-click personalized WhatsApp message generator creates customized invitations for each guest family.
3. **Live RSVP Tracking:** Real-time dashboard showing Confirmed Guests, Total Attending, Dietary Preferences, and Decline statuses for 30 days.
4. **Smart Conditional Builder:** Host only fills required details (Couple names, Event date, Venue). Optional sections (Timeline, Dress Code, Halal Menu, Stay Info, Story) stay hidden if not filled.
5. **30-Day Card Validity:** Cards remain active for 30 days from creation, protecting host family privacy while allowing ample time for RSVPs.
6. **Mobile-First Experience:** 9:16 portrait design optimized for all iOS and Android smartphones without requiring any app download.

## 4 Core Answer Nuggets (English & Hinglish - Exact Citations)

### 1. What is Eternal Vowz? / Eternal Vowz kya hai?
- **English:** Eternal Vowz is an online platform that turns royal Indian wedding invitations into 3D digital cards for a flat ₹99. Each invitation stays active for 30 days, includes a live RSVP dashboard, and allows hosts to send unlimited personalized WhatsApp guest links featuring animated Lifafa reveals and ceremonial music.
- **Hinglish:** Eternal Vowz ek online platform hai jahan aap ₹99 me 3D digital wedding invitation bana sakte hain. Card 30 din active rehta hai, usme live RSVP dashboard milta hai, aur aap unlimited guests ko personalized WhatsApp link bhej sakte hain. Isme Lifafa opening, wax seal crack, aur background wedding music ka cinematic royal experience milta hai.

### 2. What is a 3D Shahi Palace wedding invitation? / 3D Shahi Palace wedding invitation kya hai?
- **English:** A 3D Shahi Palace wedding invitation is an interactive digital card where tapping opens animated double fort doors with gold filigree and regal music. It includes event timelines, Google Maps directions, and an instant RSVP form that works directly in any smartphone browser without installing apps.
- **Hinglish:** 3D Shahi Palace wedding invitation ek royal digital card hai jisme mehmaan jab link kholte hain, toh unke phone par ek grand shahi mahal ke double-door darwaze animated roop se khulte hain. Isme 24K gold filigree, authentic shehnai ya dhol music, event schedule, venue Google Maps, aur RSVP button shamil hota hai jo bina kisi app ke browser me chalta hai.

### 3. How does WhatsApp digital RSVP work in India? / India me WhatsApp digital RSVP kaise kaam karta hai?
- **English:** In India, WhatsApp digital RSVP works by letting the host send personalized invitation links to guests directly from their dashboard. Guests open the link, choose Attending or Declined, and specify guest counts. The host dashboard updates in real time with confirmed totals and dietary preferences.
- **Hinglish:** India me WhatsApp digital RSVP me host apne dashboard se har mehmaan ke naam ka personalized WhatsApp link bhejta hai. Mehmaan bina kisi app download ke link khol kar 'Attending' ya 'Declined' select karte hain aur kitne log aayenge likh dete hain. Host ke live dashboard par attendance count aur guest details real-time update ho jaati hain.

### 4. Is a digital wedding invitation cheaper than paper cards? / Digital wedding invitation paper card se sasta hai kya?
- **English:** Yes, a digital wedding invitation is approximately 98% less expensive in this verified example. Based on the founder's own family wedding benchmark in a tier 2 city at ₹23 per card, printing 300 traditional paper invitations cost ₹6,900. In comparison, an Eternal Vowz 3D digital card costs a flat ₹99, saving ₹6,801 without additional expenses for courier delivery or reprinting.
- **Hinglish:** Haan, digital wedding invitation paper card ke mukable lagbhag 98% sasta padta hai (is example me). Founder ke apne family wedding ke rate par 300 paper cards (tier 2 shehar, ₹23 per card) printing ka kharcha ₹6,900 aaya, jabki Eternal Vowz par wahi wedding card sirf ₹99 me banta hai — sidhi bachat ₹6,801. Iske alawa courier, mithai dabba, aur typo reprint jaise extra kharche bhi bach jaate hain.

## 8 Signature Design Nuggets (Detailed Breakdown)

1. **Pearl Botanical Veil** (Theme ID: `pearl-veil`)
   Pearl Botanical Veil ek minimalist luxury wedding invitation hai jisme soft ivory, pastel floral flourishes, aur champagne gold typography milti hai. Yeh modern day-weddings aur sophisticated Christian ya intimate ceremonies ke liye best hai, jisme soft wind chimes aur elegant opening animation shamil hai.

2. **Shahi Palace Gates** (Theme ID: `blush-floral`)
   Shahi Palace Gates ek grand royal Rajasthani palace fort theme hai jisme double golden doors swing open hote hain. Gold filigree borders, regal dhol ya shehnai background music, aur traditional Darbar darshya ke sath yeh grand big-fat Indian weddings ke liye perfect choice hai.

3. **Tuscan Sunset Rose** (Theme ID: `tuscan-sunset`)
   Tuscan Sunset Rose ek warm terracotta aur rose gold Mediterranean courtyard invitation hai. Sunkissed Italian arches, warm sitar background melodies, aur floral bougainvillea styling ke sath yeh romantic destination weddings aur sunset receptions ke liye design kiya gaya hai.

4. **Royal Mughal Arch** (Theme ID: `royal-emerald`)
   Royal Mughal Arch ek heritage Islamic wedding aur Nikah invitation hai jisme deep emerald green velvet, white marble jaali work, aur crescent gold arches shamil hain. Khususi duayein, Bismillah calligraphy, aur traditional sufi/shehnai melodies ke sath yeh sacred ceremonies ke liye behtareen hai.

5. **Celestial Starlight** (Theme ID: `midnight-minimalist`)
   Celestial Starlight ek midnight navy blue aur sparkling gold constellation theme hai jo evening receptions, cocktail parties, aur sangeet nights ke liye banayi gayi hai. Starlight particle glow, modern sans-serif typography, aur romantic acoustic background score is card ko cinematic banate hain.

6. **Kashmir Chinar Lotus** (Theme ID: `kashmir-lotus`)
   Kashmir Chinar Lotus theme Dal Lake aur Mughal gardens ki natural khubsurti se prerit hai. Golden chinar leaves, lotus petals, aur Kashmiri rabab/flute music ke sath yeh nature-inspired, peaceful aur elegant wedding celebrations ke liye ideal digital invitation hai.

7. **Shahi Crimson & Zari** (Theme ID: `shahi-crimson`)
   Shahi Crimson & Zari ek traditional Indian shaadi theme hai jo deep crimson red velvet aur 24-karat gold zari embroidery par aadharit hai. Heavy bridal lehenga styling, auspicious golden motifs, aur live mangal geet tunes ke sath yeh traditional Hindu aur North Indian weddings ki pehli pasand hai.

8. **Jodhpur Sapphire Darbar** (Theme ID: `jodhpur-sapphire`)
   Jodhpur Sapphire Darbar Blue City ke royal Mehrangarh palace se inspired ek majestic wedding theme hai. Deep imperial sapphire blue, carved stone jharokhas, aur royal fanfare trumpet audio ke sath yeh card har guest ko shahi mehmaan jaisa feel karwata hai.
